title: bookmarks
summary: Lists or finds the dl:bk comment-anchor bookmarks in a unit or a folder, and strips / restores them on request
intro: Read this when you marked code with // dl:bk3 or // dl:bk:A7K3QX comments and want them listed, or one found by its code (bookmarks, read-only), or taken out of a file and put back later (bookmarks-strip / bookmarks-restore, user-invoked, dry run without --apply).

surfaces.usage: drag-lint bookmarks --in <file.pas|dir> [--name <code>] [--format text|json] [--json] (list / find the // dl:bk<N> and // dl:bk:<CODE> comment anchors; read-only; exit 3 = none)

drag-lint bookmarks-strip --in <file.pas|dir> --out <sidecar.json> [--name <code>] [--apply] [--json] (removes the dl:bk comment anchors and records them in a sidecar for bookmarks-restore; dry run without --apply; never overwrites a sidecar; exit 3 = none)

drag-lint bookmarks-restore --from <sidecar.json> [--apply] [--json] (puts the anchors a bookmarks-strip removed back, byte-identical when the file is unchanged; a file with an anchor it cannot place is left untouched; dry run without --apply; exit 4 = some unplaced)
